defects.before: - Then the inner loop compares the mapping with every buffer. A buffer matches when the mapping starts at the buffer address and ends exactly `len` bytes after it. `cur` becomes the index of that buffer, or stays -1 when no buffer matches.
defects.after:
- At such a line `cur` is first set back to -1 (line 1529). Then the inner loop compares the mapping with every buffer. A buffer matches when the mapping starts at the buffer address and ends exactly `len` bytes after it. Then `cur` becomes the index of that buffer.
- When no buffer matches, `cur` is -1. So the lines of that mapping store nothing, and they cannot change the values of a buffer that was read before.
defects.evidence: Line 1529 of bwx12.c (`cur = -1;`) resets `cur` at every mapping line, so `cur` does not "stay" -1 after a buffer mapping; without this reset the `Size:` line of the no-access range after a buffer would overwrite the buffer's values, and the row did not explain the line.
